intent: Add a profile-independent app audit catalogue and bounded probe engine under the existing durable benchmark coordinator/store, with explicit evidence, status, coverage and score denominators.
preservation: No new coordinator, database or model profile is invented for app audits.
Save the frozen catalogue before probes and retain attempted/unknown outcomes through cancellation, storage failures and process recovery.
Use stable allowlisted probes and selected authority; never generically invoke all tools or replay uncertain work.
Keep pass/fail separate from skipped, blocked, unavailable and untested and never claim source-line coverage from functional probes.
Leave existing benchmark scores and model benchmark behavior unchanged.
